meta.name: do
meta.description: Execute a phased implementation plan using subagents. Use when asked to execute, run, or carry out a plan — especially one created by make-plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用子智能体自动执行分阶段计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果已有分步计划需要自动执行
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a step-by-step plan to execute automatically

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会变成总指挥，自动分配子任务给多个子代理执行，自己只负责协调和检查结果。
howto.when: 当你要求执行、运行或实施一个计划时触发，尤其是由 make-plan 技能创建的计划。

say.text: 执行刚才制定的分阶段计划。
say.note: Claude 会启动子代理按步骤实施。

say.text: 运行部署计划的第一阶段。
say.note: Claude 会部署实施子代理执行该阶段。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as an orchestrator, deploying subagents to execute all work, coordinating context, and verifying completion without doing the work itself.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to execute, run, or carry out a plan, especially one created by make-plan.

say_en.text: Execute the phased plan we just created.
say_en.note: Claude will deploy subagents to implement step by step.

say_en.text: Run the first phase of the deployment plan.
say_en.note: Claude will deploy an implementation subagent for that phase.
